patthana17.29:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana17.29:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana17.29:3.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika upādinnupādāniyattike nasanidassanattika naupādinnupādāniyattikaṃ
